'''Universal Kids Resort''' is a {{Convert|32|acre|ha|adj=on}} children's [[theme park]] and [[entertainment]] [[resort]] in [[Frisco, Texas]], United States. Limited test operation started on June 24, 2026, before it fully opened on July 1, 2026. It is the sixth [[Universal Destinations & Experiences|Universal Studios Resort]], and the third in the United States. The park features several themed areas based on ''[[Gabby's Dollhouse]]'', ''[[Trolls (franchise)|Trolls]]'', ''[[Shrek (franchise)|Shrek]]'' (also ''[[Puss in Boots (Shrek)|Puss in Boots]]''), ''[[Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous]]'', ''[[SpongeBob SquarePants (franchise)|SpongeBob SquarePants]]'', and ''[[Despicable Me]]''.

==Lands and attractions==
Universal Kids Resort consists of seven themed lands. In clockwise order from entry, the themed lands are based on ''[[Gabby's Dollhouse]]'', ''[[Trolls (franchise)|Trolls]]'', ''[[Shrek (franchise)|Shrek]]'', ''[[Puss in Boots (Shrek)|Puss in Boots]]'', ''[[Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous]]'', ''[[SpongeBob SquarePants (franchise)|SpongeBob SquarePants]]'',{{efn|name = Nickelodeon|The [[intellectual property]] rights are owned by [[Nickelodeon Animation Studio]] and [[United Plankton Pictures]]}} and ''[[Despicable Me]]''.<ref name="Attractions">{{cite web |url=https://attractionsmagazine.com/universal-kids-resort-theme-park-frisco-dallas-texas-2026/ |title=Universal Kids theme park in Texas: All lands revealed |website=Attractions Magazine |first=Blake |last=Taylor |date=February 21, 2025 |access-date=February 21, 2025 |archive-date=January 13, 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260113143526/https://attractionsmagazine.com/universal-kids-resort-theme-park-frisco-dallas-texas-2026/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://wdwnt.com/2025/02/breaking-themed-lands-confirmed-for-universal-kids-resort-in-texas/ |title=BREAKING: 6 Themed Lands Confirmed for Universal Kids Resort Opening in 2026 |website=WDWNT |first=Shannen |last=Ace |date=February 21, 2025 |access-date=February 22, 2025}}</ref> The themed lands consist of [[swing ride]]s, a [[river rapids ride]], an [[aerial carousel]], a [[rockin' tug|rockin' tug]], and two roller coasters.<ref name="Attractions" />

==Critical reception==
The announcement of Universal Kids Resort was met with local enthusiasm yet upon opening was immediately criticized by visitors, with many finding the park cheaply designed, utilitarian, and generally falling well below the standards of theming within other Universal parks<ref>{{Cite web |last=Reid |first=Caroline |title=How To Fix Universal Kids Resort |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/carolinereid/2026/07/06/how-to-fix-universal-kids-resort/ |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=Forbes |language=en}}</ref>. Many reviews also criticize the park for lacking appropriate shade while being situated in Texas, while other reviews described it as "ugly, underthemed ... barren concrete stretches" that overall reflect "a type of cheapness and tackiness".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sundstrom |first=Jacob |title=Universal Kids Resort: What were they thinking? |url=https://www.themeparkinsider.com/flume/202606/12512/ |access-date=2026-07-30 |website=Theme Park Insider |language=en}}</ref>
